diagnosis: In all four rollouts, the model approved restructuring with a 12-month maturity extension and released $900,000 of equipment collateral, despite never having access to PF2. This indicates that the model is defaulting to approving such extensions and releases without the required borrower contribution, as specified in PF2. The model likely uses a default value or heuristic that allows for these actions without needing the precise details from PF2.

C1.why: Without PF2, the bank has no confirmed new capital supporting an executable approval; PF2 changes the required borrower contribution to exactly $1,200,000 and requires an equity-related implementation commitment.
